subject: 马村一号墓妇人启门砖雕壁面局部
caption: 马村砖雕墓 · 一号墓妇人启门
金代 · 墓室砖雕局部线描
source_note: 实际照片为一号墓妇人启门壁面。图版只转绘中央三间仿木砖雕、启门侍女与两侧人物故事浮雕，省略转角侧壁、穹顶和照片下缘不完整的雕刻；不是地面保护建筑或完整墓室复原。人物面部和小型纹样作线描概括，不作为考古测绘。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one fine-line heritage illustration for the 访古 collection.
Input 1 is STYLE ONLY: the existing Longmen Vairocana contour drawing; match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic fine lines, restrained detail and generous white spaces. Input 2 is ACTUAL SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: a photograph of the Jin-period brick relief interior of Tomb 1 at Macun, Jishan, Shanxi, the woman opening a door. It is a tomb interior relief, not an exterior building.
Draw the central frontal THREE-BAY wall fragment visible in the photograph, isolated on pure white: four brick-carved columns, three lintel bays and the corresponding visible bracket sets above, central partly open double door with ONE small maid sculpture peeking from behind the right-hand door leaf into the left opening (head, folded arms and lower robe visible as photographed), narrative figure relief panels in the left and right bays, and the shallow lotus-edged platform beneath. Retain the photographed asymmetry of the door and figure. Show only the central wall, omitting the angled side walls, overhead vault and the lower cut-off frieze. End the fragment naturally just above the visible bracket arms and below the platform. Do not invent a complete chamber, ceiling, outer roof, facade, extra people or missing features. All people retained here are actual relief sculpture, not tourists. Keep the major positions of the small narrative figures and flags in the two side panels, but simplify their tiny interior ornament so the image remains readable.
Refined sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE. Fine confident outlines, a few finer internal structural lines. Every surface and recess remains WHITE, including doorway interior. No black-filled shadows, no gray, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no color, no texture or gradients. Leave broad empty surfaces; indicate only selective carving contours, not every brick joint. No writing, watermark, labels, numbers, frame or border. Front view with verticals upright; delicate volume through only outlines. Landscape 1536 x 1024, the entire selected relief fragment centered within 82% of canvas width, breathing room all around. All included columns, platform and bracket silhouette remain uncut.

historical_sources.title: 商旅驼铃名海内，山河远阔福卫峰——2023级美术学班赴山西考察

historical_sources.evidence: 实地观察一号墓妇人启门、二号墓宴饮、五号墓双狮与八号墓仿木结构；将段氏墓地断于金大定以前。

historical_sources.title: 马村砖雕墓报道
historical_sources.publisher: 人民日报海外版，2016年11月9日第6版
historical_sources.evidence: 马村墓群主要为北宋晚期至金前期，仿四合院砖雕保存宋金社会生活图像；各墓年代不宜视为同一确切年份。

coordinates.note: 马村砖雕墓博物馆古迹位置，非稷山县城中心。

site_recommendation.name: 马村砖雕墓
site_recommendation.era: 金代 · 仿木砖雕墓室
site_recommendation.yearNote: 1150仅作金代前期的约略排序点，不是某墓确切入葬年；墓群整体跨北宋晚期至金代。
site_recommendation.place: 山西稷山 · 稷峰镇马村
site_recommendation.lede: 砖砌墓室里，斗栱、门窗与栏槛组成地下宅院。一号墓的小侍女从半掩门后探身，身旁的故事浮雕把宋金生活留在细小的砖面上。

facts.label: 地下宅院
facts.text: 墓室用砖雕模拟木构住宅，柱、斗栱、门窗与平台共同构成建筑空间。

facts.label: 妇人启门
facts.text: 一号墓中央门扉半开，侍女从门后探身；两侧保留人物故事浮雕。

facts.label: 宋金墓群
facts.text: 墓群整体年代涉及北宋晚期至金代，本图选择金代前期一号墓局部，不代表全部墓室。
